_comment: Minimal fixture for the RP2040 boot/connect smoke test. No analog_in / i2c / step_trigger entries - the test just verifies that the firmware boots through clock_setup in main.c (CLOCKS sets CLK_<x>_SELECTED = 1<<CTRL.SRC, RESETS sets RESET_DONE = ~RESET, XOSC sets STATUS.STABLE when CTRL.ENABLE field == 0xFAB, PLL_SYS / PLL_USB set CS.LOCK when PWR.PD bit cleared - all four are bit-set synthesis stubs runtime-injected by renode_launcher.py), the chip-specific 64-bit / 1MHz timer (Timers.RP2040_Timer C# model loaded via `i @rp2040_timer.cs` before LoadPlatformDescription) advances the firmware's view of the system clock, and klippy completes its identify + clocksync handshake over the UART0 (PL011) pty Renode exposes.
